name: One-Pan Fall Chicken With Sweet Potatoes and Apples

cookwares.name: 12-inch cast iron skillet or stainless steel skillet

ingredients.name: minced fresh rosemary leaves, plus more for serving if desired

instructions.primary_message: Pat the bone-in skin-on chicken thighs dry. Peel and cut the sweet potato into 1 1/2-inch cubes. Cut the cold unsalted butter into small pieces.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 bone-in skin-on chicken thighs
0.15 kg sweet potato
2 tbsp cold unsalted butter

instructions.primary_message: Adjust oven rack to middle position and preheat oven to 230°C (450°F). Season chicken evenly with 2 teaspoons kosher salt and 1/2 teaspoon pepper. In a 30-cm cast iron or stainless steel skillet, add oil and heat over medium-high heat until shimmering. Arrange chicken skin side down in skillet and cook, undisturbed, until skin is deeply browned and releases easily from skillet, about 8 minutes. Transfer chicken to a large plate, skin side up.

Add sweet potatoes, shallots, rosemary, thyme, 1/2 teaspoon kosher salt, and remaining 1/2 teaspoon pepper to skillet and cook over medium-high heat, stirring occasionally, until sweet potatoes begin to brown, about 3 minutes. Add apple and cook, stirring occasionally, until lightly browned, about 2 minutes. Remove from heat.

Nestle chicken into sweet potato mixture, skin side up, and pour any accumulated juices from plate into skillet. Transfer skillet to oven and cook until apples and sweet potatoes are tender and an instant-read thermometer inserted into thickest part of chicken registers 175 to 85°C (80 to 85°C), about 20 minutes.
Transfer chicken and sweet potato mixture to a serving platter and let chicken rest for 5 minutes.

Meanwhile, using a kitchen towel or oven mitt to handle hot skillet, return skillet to stovetop over medium-high heat. Add wine and mustard and cook, stirring and scraping up any browned bits from bottom of skillet, until wine is almost completely evaporated, about 3 minutes. Add chicken stock and cook, stirring often, until slightly reduced, about 3 minutes. Stir in apple cider vinegar, maple syrup, and remaining 1/2 teaspoon kosher salt. Remove from heat and gradually whisk in butter until sauce is smooth and glossy, about 1 minute. Top chicken and sweet potato mixture with sauce and sprinkle with minced rosemary and torn sage leaves, if using. Serve.

description: This easy one-pan chicken dinner pairs juicy thighs with tender sweet potatoes, caramelized apples, and a tangy, buttery pan sauce.
notes:
Optional or for serving: Torn fresh sage leaves, for serving (optional)

Optional substitutions: homemade chicken stock → store-bought unsalted chicken broth

Make-ahead and storage: Leftovers can be refrigerated in an airtight container for up to 4 days.
author: Laila Ibrahim
